About us description: We are engineers who got tired of writing the same PLC structures by hand. So we build generators: software that takes over the repetitive part and leaves the engineering decisions to people. We connect industrial automation with .NET and modern web tooling.
About us point1: Industrial automation experience, not a software agency
About us point2: Your standard encoded once in a generator and reused in every project
About us point3: From input data to a TIA Portal project in one toolchain
Services description: Three things, one goal: less manual PLC work. We generate code, build the tools around the generator and program PLCs where an engineer's decision is still required.
ServiceGeneratorDesc: VASS PLC Creator and custom generators: input data becomes code ready to import into TIA Portal.
ServiceSoftwareDesc: Desktop and web applications around the generator — from preparing input data to importing the project.
ServicePlcDesc: PLC development when the generator is not enough: non-standard machines, integrations, fixes in existing code.
Platform title: All your tools in one place
Platform description: We are building a platform around our generators. One place to prepare input data, generate code, manage the library and import the result into TIA Portal. Custom generators and AI plug into the same workflow.

Platform tool2 description: Your own generation rules in C# on top of TIA Portal Openness.
Platform tool3 description: Imports the generated package and builds the project structure automatically.
Platform tool4 description: Client-specific standards and conventions, designed and built with you.
Platform tool5 description: Logic suggestions based on requirements. Premium layer, coming soon.

Product1 Description3: Reduction of PLC program writing costs.

Product1 Description6: Improving the quality of the PLC program.

Product1 Description9: Facilitation of the programming process (reduction of required offline competencies).
Product2 Description: Static library written in .NET standard. Enables generating of the PLC program (LAD) in C# language.
Product2 Description1: Full support for TIA Portal Openness.

Vass description: VASS PLC Creator turns your input data — EPLAN tags, safety matrix and structure — into a complete TIA Portal project ready to import. Built for the VASS standard, free in its core, with AI as a premium layer.
Vass availability: Free core · AI premium coming soon
Portal coming soon: Portal in beta — more features coming soon.
Vass workflow title: From input data to TIA Portal in three steps
Vass workflow description: No hand-written blocks. Feed the standard data you already have and get a complete, consistent project out.
Vass step1 description: Bring in EPLAN / CAEX structure, safety matrix and the SPS matrix. The generator parses it into a project model.
Vass step2 description: Shape zones, sub-zones, robots, stations and the part-flow. Everything maps to the VASS structure.
Vass step3 description: Produce DB, FB, FC, OB1, ARG, safety and station blocks, tag tables and communication — packed as a ready .s7z archive.
Vass features description: The generator covers the full standard, so the repetitive part is automated and only real engineering decisions are left to you.
Vass feature1 description: Line, stations, robots and structure read directly from your engineering data.
Vass feature2 description: Safety logic generated from the .xlsm matrix, block by block.
Vass feature3 description: PutPart / TakePart / Enter / Exit with combined variants and edge actions.
Vass feature4 description: Several PLCs, zones and sub-zones in one coherent project structure.
Vass feature5 description: Main ARG block plus per-station and per-robot logic, generated consistently.
Vass feature6 description: Tag tables and communication setup included in the generated project.
Vass feature7 description: Titles and texts generated in standardized, localized forms (de-DE and more).
Vass feature8 description: Output packed as an archive, ready to import via TIA Project Importer.
Vass screenshots description: Structure tree, part-flow canvas and one-click generation — the screens below show the layout. Real product screenshots replace these mockups soon.
Vass screenshots note: These are layout mockups. Real screenshots land here once the product is available.
Vass audience title: Made for line integrators and automation engineers
Vass audience1 description: Standardize every line and cut repetitive programming to almost zero.
Vass audience2 description: Focus on the non-standard logic; let the generator handle the boilerplate.
Vass audience3 description: Import a ready project instead of building it block by block.
Vass premium description: The core generator stays free. AI lands as a premium layer, in two levels, once it is ready.
Vass core tier description: The full VASS generator: input data in, TIA-ready project out.
Vass core bullet2: EPLAN, safety and SPS matrix import
Vass ai tier description: AI support across the workflow, in two levels.
Vass ai level1 description: An assistant that helps you configure the project faster and with fewer mistakes.
Vass ai level2 description: The generator itself uses AI to build logic from requirements.
Vass premium note: AI features are coming soon and will be announced here when available.

Vass cta note: Access is granted individually. Documentation is public.
